title: Fix Alignment direct-launch hang on sequence uploads
observed_behavior: When these uploaded sequence-bearing fixtures are launched with File Settings default view set to Alignment View, the app is not reliably interactive after processing. During Alignment test authoring, Cypress observed the Processing Files dialog remain visible indefinitely on some runs and a zero-width Alignment canvas on others.
intended_behavior: The Processing Files dialog should clear and the uploaded network should reach a fully rendered, interactive Alignment View on the direct-launch path.
cause_summary: Alignment did not release the shared network-rendered completion path on direct launch, and its first layout pass could compute unstable dimensions before the Golden Layout container settled.
fix_summary: Alignment now performs a post-render layout sync, clamps width and height calculations away from negative or NaN states, and explicitly releases the shared processing modal on direct launch once the Alignment surface is ready.
notes: Resolved on 2026-04-04. The maintained direct-launch Alignment smoke now passes across FASTA sequence-node and node+link uploaded fixtures, and the existing launch-then-switch Alignment smoke still passes.

title: Expose Alignment ruler minor interval 0 option
observed_behavior: When Cypress opens the Ruler Minor Interval control in Alignment settings, positive values such as 20 are selectable but the documented 0 value is not surfaced as a selectable option in the dropdown.
intended_behavior: The Alignment Ruler Minor Interval control should expose 0 so users can remove minor ruler ticks, matching the component's declared rulerIntervalOptions and help text.
cause_summary: The ruler interval control was relying on a falsy `0` primitive option path that was not surfaced reliably by the PrimeNG select binding.
fix_summary: The ruler interval control now uses explicit label/value options with explicit PrimeNG option bindings, and the maintained zero-interval assertions were restored with a more reliable visible-overlay selection path.
notes: Resolved on 2026-04-04. The maintained advanced Alignment settings suite now verifies both positive ruler intervals and the `0` branch that removes minor ticks.

title: Handle unsupported Alignment inputs without crash
observed_behavior: Switching these uploaded non-sequence datasets into Alignment View surfaced the red runtime-error banner and left Alignment in a broken blank state during test authoring.
intended_behavior: Alignment should remain stable on unsupported inputs and communicate that no sequence-bearing nodes are available for the current dataset.
cause_summary: Alignment accepted non-biological seq-like strings as sequences and attempted to render zero-or-invalid alignment canvases for unsupported datasets.
fix_summary: Sequence detection is now stricter for uploaded Alignment rows, zero-sequence canvases are rendered safely, and Alignment shows an explicit empty-state message for unsupported inputs.
notes: Discovered while authoring unsupported-input coverage and fixed in the same pass; tracker row A013 is now covered by the maintained empty-state spec.
